JOIN US IN COPENHAGEN TO HUMANISE BRANDS, SPARK HAPPINESS AND ORCHESTRATE INTERNATIONAL CLIENT PARTNERSHIPS

The Role: Driving World-Class Brand Development

Everland is looking for a full-time, on-site International Client Director to join our Copenhagen office

and drive the Client Service role for some of our key international client collaborations.

Being part of our Clients Services team, you will have a key role in our client collaborations, working

alongside Strategy, Creative, and Realisation to ensure our partnerships are as operationally

seamless as they are ambitious and impactful.

Your Mission: To Be "On It"

Your success is measured by the health of the relationship and the excellence of the delivery. You are

a high-level orchestrator of complex work streams, with responsibilities including:

• Service Excellence & Responsiveness: Providing the responsiveness that our clients crave. You are the primary point of contact for the ongoing collaboration, soaking up everyday tasks and solving tactical challenges with pragmatic, "can-do" energy.

• Master of Project Management: You take absolute ownership of the project management fundamentals. You lead the full brand and design development lifecycle, from defining initial scopes and meticulous budgeting to resource planning and timeline precision. You are the guardian of the brief and process, ensuring nothing is left out or to chance.

• Driving & Shaping Partnerships: You manage the full spectrum of client needs. This ranges from leading extensive, long-term brand development programmes to flawlessly coordinating the day-to-day tasks that keep a global brand moving.

• Team Integration: Acting as the operational glue within our teams. You bridge the gap between the strategic intent, the creative vision, and the client’s operational reality, ensuring that every project is delivered on time, on budget, and beyond expectation.

• "Beyond the Brief": Acting as the operational "eyes and ears" with your clients. Because you are so close to the daily work, you identify opportunities to create value beyond the initial scope, proactively proposing ways we can help clients solve their next challenge.

Your Profile: ‘Pro’ with International Outlook and Scandinavian Heart

We are looking for a team player who balances a professional "Director-level" weight with a

flat-hierarchy, sleeves-up mindset.

• The Experience: 10+ years of relevant professional experience. This must include at least 5 years of agency-side experience managing international clients within the consumer goods / FMCG industry.

• The Operational Specialist: You are a project manager by trade and a problem-solver by nature. You have the seniority to sit at the table with senior client stakeholders, but you have never lost your love for the "basics" of a perfectly managed workflow.

• The Commercial Driver: Commercially astute and growth-oriented. You possess a deep curiosity about your clients' business realities, allowing you to shape strategic solutions that truly address their needs while proactively identifying and driving organic growth opportunities for Everland.

• The Mindset: Resilient, energetic, and proactive. You don’t just flag problems; you take ownership. You take pride in "owning the machine" and making complex projects feel effortless for the client.

• The Collaborator: You thrive in a flat organisation. You are an empathic and natural team player who values the collective win over individual ego and understands the "One Team" philosophy across our functions and offices.

• The International: Some client-related travel activity (mainly Europe) must be expected, and your professional English must be flawless as this will be the main language in your client communications. As you will be based in Copenhagen, mastering a Scandinavian language is a nice bonus, but by no means a necessity.

Why Everland?

You will have a central role in an agency where we value freedom, responsibility, and the "One Team"

mindset. You will join a culture that plays to win but never forgets to spark happiness and keep it

human. Here, you will have the space to leave your mark on some of the world’s most famous

consumer brands while helping shape the future of our international Client Service approach.

Practical Information

• How to apply: Apply via LinkedIn or email your application and CV to our Head of Client Services, Emilie Aagreen emaa@everlandagency.com

• Deadline: ASAP – we will be conducting interviews on an ongoing basis.

• Start date: By agreement.

About Everland

We help Humanise Brands to shape culture and drive sustainable value. Based on our human-centric

approach, we help brands grow with Character and Charisma. In everything they do, and everywhere

they are. Our Scandinavian DNA defines our way of working: an inclusive, direct, and ego-free approach to collaboration — with each other, our clients, and other agency partners alike.

Everland is an international brand and design partner specialised in FMCG brand worlds. We deliver

end-to-end expertise across brand strategy, visual and verbal identity, design realisation, and brand

guardianship.

We are proudly independent, entrepreneurs at heart, and consider ourselves challengers on the

international agency scene. This allows us to stay nimble, focused, and deeply committed to the

brands we nurture.

**Job Description

**We at Danske Bank connect global markets and help businesses grow. As Head of Guarantees, you will lead our guarantee teams across the Nordics, shaping the strategic direction of our business that sits at the heart of our Trade and Working Capital Solutions offering.

**What You Will Be Doing

**This is an opportunity to combine deep financial expertise with people leadership and digital innovation. You will join the Trade and Working Capital Solutions department, reporting to the Co-head and working within a matrix organisation that spans countries and functions. The team is collaborative and commercially minded, with a shared commitment to delivering consistent, high-quality service to clients. You will partner closely with teams across the organization and represent the guarantees business in internal forums and external industry discussions.

More specifically, you will:

• Set and execute the strategic direction for the guarantees business across the Nordics

• Lead the transformation of guarantee processes using AI, digitalisation and automation

• Develop and grow the guarantee teams, building capabilities and a clear succession pipeline

• Partner with sales and advisory teams to deliver guarantee solutions that meet client needs

• Ensure all activities comply with legal, regulatory and internal governance requirements

• Use business and service measures to identify improvements and build operational resilience

**About You

**

• Degree in finance, economics, business or a related discipline

• Comprehensive knowledge of banking and global trade

• Demonstrated experience leading and developing specialist teams

• Strong understanding of AI, digitalisation and their responsible application in banking

• Comfortable working across countries and functions in a matrix organisation

• Clear commercial judgement with sound risk management awareness

• Professional fluency in English and at least one Nordic language

Familiarity with relevant legal and regulatory frameworks across multiple Nordic markets is an advantage. Experience with succession planning and talent development would also be a welcome addition, supporting you in your transformational leadership role.

**What We Offer You

**This is an opportunity to shape the future of Danske Bank’s guarantees business across the Nordics and lead its transformation. You will be offered a competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, in addition to real opportunities for professional growth and development. Working alongside knowledgeable and supportive colleagues, you will spend three to four days per week in the office whilst we offer you the flexibility to work in a way that fits your life. This position can be based on our modern offices in any Nordic country.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this role sounds like the right fit for you, we would be glad to hear from you. To apply, please send your CV and cover letter via our recruitment system by November 11th, 2026.

For questions about the role, please reach out to hiring manager Jukka Kuusala at jukka.kuusala@danskebank.fi or +358 (0)50 336 6476. Jukka is best available on November 2nd at 13-15 (CET) and November 6th at 13-15 (CET).

We look forward to hearing from you!

AI is changing how software gets built.

The data underneath it matters more than ever.

At Heyra, we build operational AI: systems, workflows, and data platforms that live in production from day one. We work with companies that are moving quickly and need solutions that improve the way they operate.

We’re looking for a Data Engineer who enjoys building things properly. Someone who can move through complex systems, shape clean architecture and create the foundations modern AI workflows depend on.

You’ll work closely with engineers, AI specialists, strategists and designers in a company where ideas move quickly and the distance from thinking to building is intentionally small.

**What You’ll Work On

**

• Building modern data platforms and pipelines

• Creating semantic foundations for AI systems

• Developing AI-powered workflows and agentic systems

• Helping clients move AI into real operational environments

• Working closely with both technical teams and decision makers

**Requirements

Why Heyra

We are around 45 people today, and we are only just getting started.

If this sounds like your kind of work, send us a short note about yourself together with your CV. We care much more about curiosity, energy and the way you think than polished applications.

We’re looking for a hands-on finance leader to own and build our finance function as we scale. You’ll work side by side with our founders and leadership team on strategic decisions, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. This is for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and who wants to have a big impact on how we scale in the future.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You’ll be a key strategic leader at Pandektes, shaping our current financial setup and optimising it for scale.

We’re looking for a commercially minded finance leader who thrives in high-growth environments and understands what it takes to scale a company from early traction.

You will own and evolve the finance function end-to-end; from building scalable financial infrastructure to partnering closely with our CEO and board on strategic decisions. You’ll combine sharp financial thinking with hands-on execution, ensuring we have the insights, structure, and capital needed to scale responsibly and ambitiously.

As part of the leadership team you’ll play a key role in scaling Pandektes. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both strategic finance and operational execution.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Own and evolve Pandektes’ financial strategy, ensuring our financial setup scales with our growth ambitions

• Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and leadership team on company-wide decisions

• Set up and continuously improve operational finance processes, systems, and controls

• Fully own business performance metrics, in particular providing insight into key SaaS indicators to drive business performance, support strategic decision-making and identify opportunities for profitable growth

• Own company-wide budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning

• Work with external partners on accounting, audits, compliance etc.

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Significant experience in high-growth startups or scale-ups, ideally in a VC- or PE-backed environment

• Proven track record leading or playing a central role in fundraising (Series A/B/C and beyond) and/or M&A processes

• Solid understanding of operational finance, including setting up finance functions from scratch or early stage

• Deep experience in excel modelling with a proven track record of delivering automation to manual and complicated processes

• Comfort in dealing with transactional level detail where required in advance of automation and process improvement

• Proven experience with budgeting, forecasting, and P&L management

• Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn financial data into clear business insights

• You are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive in fast-moving environments

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value curiosity and the generosity to bring other people along. If you find something useful, show us. If an experiment fails, we’d like to hear about that too.

We believe that ownership is what brings us the best teams – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich. This role will be based in our Copenhagen HQ.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + an attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• A central office in Copenhagen, where you can work closely with an ambitious and growing team

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

_

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly organized and scientifically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Documentation to lead technical support for ChemoMetec’s portfolio of analytical cell-counting instruments. In this support-centered role, you will handle technical inquiries from both customers and colleagues and act as the go-to reference for technically accurate and compliant solutions. The role combines life science, technical documentation, and QA collaboration, making it ideal for someone with a strong scientific background and a passion for structured problem-solving.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on documentation and one on data analysis. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with QA, Field Application Scientists, and product teams to resolve customer complaints, complete technical documentation, and maintain our support infrastructure. A solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, along with a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements, is essential to succeed in this role.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide technical support across all instrument platforms, with a focus on structured problem-solving and documentation.

• Collaborate with QA to complete technical questionnaires and support the resolution of customer complaints.

• Maintain and organize our support database platform, ensuring technical records are accurate and accessible.

• Proofread and write technical notes, user guides, and comparison studies.

• Develop and implement procedures to support both existing and new products.

• Ensure all support activities comply with GMP and relevant quality standards.

• Act as a subject matter expert on instrumentation and scientific applications, providing technical insight to internal teams.

Your Profile

• PhD in Biology, Physics, or a related scientific discipline.

• Solid foundation in mathematics and validation methodologies, and a strong understanding of GMP regulatory requirements.

• Strong understanding of microscopy, analytical instrumentation, and pharmaceutical workflows.

• Highly organized, structured, and detail-oriented.

• Excellent written communication skills, with experience producing technical documentation.

• Familiarity with support platforms or ticketing systems is a plus.

• Comfortable working cross-functionally in a fast-paced, technical environment.

Why join ChemoMetec?

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

Practical information

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

If you have any further questions about this job opportunity, feel free to contact Frederikke Hvidberg, fhv@chemometec.com

Your Mission

You’ll be the person who makes sure Klimate’s numbers are accurate, on time and a reliable source of truth. As our Finance Manager, you’ll own the books, the close and the reporting, as well as the data behind them. You’ll make sure what goes into our finance reports is correct, traceable and something leadership can rely on.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys both finance and data. The foundation is finance: closing the books, reconciling balances and working with our external bookkeepers and auditors. Alongside that, you’ll use SQL, BI and automation, including AI, to validate data across systems, remove manual steps and improve how finance and operations work together. If you like figuring things out and building the solution yourself, there’s a lot of room to do that here.

Finance at Klimate is closely tied to the business. Every contract, credit delivery and supplier payment shows up in the numbers, so you’ll get a front-row view of how the company actually runs. You’ll work side by side with our CFO on strategic matters, while still rolling up your sleeves to get the foundations right. You’ll have a big impact on how we scale.

About Klimate

At Klimate, we enable companies pursuing real climate action to take responsibility for the emissions they can’t avoid. The world talks a lot about net-zero, but most companies struggle to know what to do once reductions are no longer enough. That’s where we come in. We are a science-led business with real experts guiding companies through the world of carbon removal and how they can safely invest in taking CO₂ out of the atmosphere. Our solution combines expertise, guidance and software to help companies understand what’s real, what works, what it costs, and how to do it credibly.

Founded in 2020, we are a tight-knit team of around 20 people from a great variety of nationalities united by a passion for scaling solutions to the climate crisis. We move quickly when it matters and focus on sharing ownership along the way. Besides working in teams we enable that ownership in squads making it possible for all employees to lead areas, they are passionate about. We value deep collaboration and working side-by-side in our central Copenhagen office, from where we support leading clients including Implement Consulting, Nykredit, Copenhagen Airport and many others.

You can get to know us a bit better on our website or on LinkedIn.

What You'll Do

In your first 3–6 months: keep the numbers right and make the data trustworthy

• Learn Klimate’s commercial and accounting flows from contracts and allocation through invoicing, payments, credit delivery, revenue recognition and balance-sheet treatment.

• Own the month-end and year-end close from start to finish. You’ll work with our external bookkeeper and make sure the final numbers are right, keep payables and receivables on track, follow up on late payments, and support the annual audit.

• Be the quality gate for our external bookkeepers. Give them the right input, check their output, and make sure what reaches the CFO is correct.

• Deliver practical improvements to priority finance/data flows and reporting processes, reducing manual hand-offs and reconciliation where possible. This includes establishing a documented discrepancy-management process.

• Spot the first manual, error-prone steps in our workflows and start fixing them.

• Support with operational and ad hoc tasks that keep the business running smoothly.

From there: build what’s missing and give management the full picture

• Build the dashboards and overviews leadership uses to steer the company, from cash and margins to carbon-credit stock.

• Collaborate closely with the CFO on management reporting. Support budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning.

• Decide how new deal types, supplier agreements and carbon-credit purchases should be handled in our accounting, and make sure the treatment holds up at audit.

• Set up and continuously improve our finance processes, systems and controls. Automate wherever it makes sense, using whatever tools fit, AI included.

• Own reliable, traceable datasets and reporting that support finance and cross-functional decisions.

• Lead a prioritised roadmap for improving end-to-end data flows and related processes across finance, purchasing, allocation and stock. Collaborate with technical colleagues on integrations and data-models, including bringing AI-supported automations into our workflows.

Requirements and Skills

Must-haves

• Solid accounting experience, including owning the books for a whole entity, with a strong understanding of the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow. You take pride in reconciliations that tie out, and you always trace discrepancies back to their source.

• Experience with the full finance cycle: month-end close, management reporting, annual accounts and working with auditors.

• Advanced Excel modelling skills, practical SQL experience such as writing queries and joining datasets, and a good understanding of BI tools.

• Experience with automating workflows, tasks or reporting, and using AI in practice. You’ve taken manual, complicated processes and made them faster, simpler or automatic.

• Financial analysis skills and the ability to turn data and numbers into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

• Professional English is required. Being able to read and understand Danish is preferred.

Nice-to-have

• Solid knowledge of Danish accounting rules, VAT and statutory reporting requirements.

• Experience from a smaller company, with hands-on internal finance ownership.

• Knowledge of carbon credit and allowance allocation is a plus.

• Experience and interest in climate, sustainability or carbon markets is highly valued.

Who You Are

• Reliable and trustworthy, with high integrity. You check your own work and make sure the underlying data and the reporting agree.

• Self-driven and you follow through. You see tasks through to completion and ask for input along the way when you need it.

• Energised by a blank page. You’re comfortable with ambiguity and enjoy building structure where there isn’t any yet.

• Curious about the business. You want to understand why the numbers look the way they do, not just report them.

• A clear communicator. You work well across teams, and you’re not afraid to hold others accountable. You have the judgement to know when to push back, and the pragmatism to find a way that works.

What We Offer

Beyond our mission and team culture, we aim to provide a workplace where you can grow professionally and contribute meaningfully to an industry that is rapidly evolving. We offer a competitive compensation package, opportunities to develop your skills, and an environment built on ownership, collaboration and trust.

Benefits

• Vacation: 30 days of paid holiday (5 weeks + 1 week of “feriefridage”).

• Pension & health insurance: Employer-supported pension scheme including health insurance.

• Learning & development: Annual learning budget to support your professional growth.

• Warrants: Eligibility for our warrant program depending on role and seniority.

• Flexibility: We have a weekly work from home day, and offer flexibility in working times and locations as needed.

• Central office location with lunch and great coffee: Cozy office located right next to Nørreport with a catered vegetarian lunch every day and excellent coffee provided by our clients Original Coffee and Prolog.

• Social activities: Weekly wrap up sessions every Friday and a variety of social activities, from foraging and cooking in Amager to trying our hand at pottery.

Start & Logistics

We will review applications on an ongoing basis and hire when we find the right candidate.

Start date: ASAP

They possess foundational knowledge and skills, acquired through education, training, and practical experience. Typically guided by a Senior Expert and/or mentor)

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**R&D Quality encompasses four teams GCLP/GLP Quality, PV Quality, Audit Calibration, Quality and GCP Quality. R&D Quality has a large range of stakeholders, and we have an important role in delivering our 2030 vision to transform the future of cancer treatment.

In the role as AD GCP Inspection Office you will be driving day-to-day GCP Quality activities including audit together with a dedicated and highly skilled team. Furthermore, you will be taking up the role as GCP Inspection QA lead.

The role requires profound understanding of how the GCP requirements are applied into practice, especially with focus on the European requirements and interpretation of ICH GCP R3 and Computerized Systems in Clinical Trials.

The role includes hands on GCP Quality activities such as support to our many stakeholders as well as performing audits alone or together with own team members or with support from neighbouring teams. You become a key member of the R&D Quality leadership team that together drives people engagement, setting strategies and ensuring R&D Quality deliverables.

The role requires strong collaboration capabilities in an international setting across various QA departments as well across the company with target stakeholders such as Clinical Trial Operations, Clinical Data, Integration & Reporting, Digital Development, Medical, GDS&PV, and Regulatory Affairs.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Reporting to Director and Team Lead Inspection Office R&D Quality

• It will ensure GCP inspection readiness across cross functional clinical -study team.

• The role oversees end-of-end inspection planning and execution including logistics and stakeholder coordination.

• Lead and oversee GCP inspection readiness/preparation activities and serve as an inspection lead for regulatory health authority inspection including but not limited to US FDA, MHRA, EMA, CFDI, PMDA etc.

• Collaborate with the cross functional clinical study teams to develop and execute and integrated risk-based inspection readiness/preparation strategy ensuring consistent alignment across functions.

• Manage end to end inspection readiness/preparation activities, including development and maintenance of inspection storyboards with the SMEs, proactive identification and mitigation of the inspection related risk and planning, facilitation.

• Lead the mock inspections for high-risk trials across Genmab locations.

• During the inspection coordinate and assign inspection requests to appropriate SMEs providing oversight and appropriate SME, also guide to ensure timely and effective responses.

• Create/revise appropriate tools / SOPs for inspection readiness/preparation and management.

• Ensure Veeva records are updated for inspection records or related records.

• Demonstrate ability to solve complex problems requiring in-depth evaluation of various factors.

• Fulfill inspection commitments and respond to the inspection and carry out post inspection activities.

• Maintain a central repository of global inspection status and updates

• Meticulous attention to detail, excellent review skills and ability to independently manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.

• Support/manage site inspection in collaboration with GCP Quality.

• Lead and facilitate post-inspection lessons learned session to trends, share best practices and drive sustainable process improvements.

**Requirements

**

• MS, or BS or similar in Natural Science

• 10+ years of experience in a GCP Quality function or similar

• Deep expertise in GCP processes and the EMA, PMDA and FDA requirements.

• Demonstrated leadership in regulatory inspections and health authority interactions.

• Considered to be a Domain Expert within GCP by peers with a strong interest and ability to educate others

• Experience as Lead Auditor within GCP is an advantage

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK732.768,00---1.099.152,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

At Epona in Vejle, you will lead the engineering organization behind our Legal-Tech SaaS platform, used by more than 800 law firms and corporate legal departments worldwide. Our platform is built with .NET 10, C#, Azure services, REST APIs and semantic search.

Do you understand complex business processes, question assumptions and turn real needs into solutions developers can build? Join our product team in Aarhus and help shape the in-house systems supporting global commodity trading, risk management and financial operations!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Business Analyst, who can bridge business stakeholders and our development team. You will get close to the users, understand how the business creates value and manages risk, and translate complex needs into clear, prioritized backlog items. The goal is simple: to ensure that we build the right things, not only build things right.

This is an operational and influential role in a collaborative product team. You will be expected to ask “why”, create clarity, speak up and help the team make pragmatic decisions in a complex domain. You will not be coding, but you have enough technical understanding to discuss services, data and integrations credibly with developers.

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will work directly with end users and business stakeholders to understand their processes, pain points and goals. You will constructively question requirements to uncover the real need behind requests and challenge initiatives that do not create sufficient value. Based on these insights, you will map and document business processes, data flows and system-supported capabilities, translating business needs into clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria that the development team can act on.

In addition, you will:

• Partner closely with the Product Owner and support prioritization based on business value, risk and dependencies.

• Participate actively in refinement and act as the go-to person for business questions during development.

• Maintain the big-picture view of how changes affect services, integrations and downstream processes across the trade lifecycle.

• Use AI tools to accelerate analysis and documentation, while critically reviewing and improving the output.

• Help the team and the business identify practical, responsible ways of applying AI in everyday workflows.

The environment you will join

You will become part of an agile product team, with a closely involved Product Owner and a culture where decisions are made together. There is no ivory tower. We expect colleagues to contribute their perspective, challenge ideas respectfully and take shared ownership of the outcome.

The team builds and develops in-house systems covering the trade lifecycle from capturing derivative trades through risk management to invoicing. The users work within Global Risk Management, and the solutions operate in a service-oriented landscape based on .NET and Azure, with a combination of on-premises infrastructure and Kubernetes.

The role is based at our Aarhus office, where close day-to-day collaboration matters. Depending on business needs, you should also expect occasional visits to Middelfart.

What we are looking for

We imagine that you have several years of experience as a Business Analyst, Business Architect, Product Owner, Functional Consultant or in a comparable role. More importantly, you have repeatedly demonstrated that you can understand complexity and turn it into concrete, value-creating deliverables.

You have demonstrated the ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into clear, actionable deliverables. You are also comfortable writing user stories and acceptance criteria and contributing effectively in agile or Scrum-based product teams.

We also imagine that you bring:

• Practical use of AI tools in daily work, for example to analyze information, draft requirements, summarize stakeholder input or map processes, combined with sound critical judgement.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to bring business and technical stakeholders into alignment

• Ability to align stakeholders constructively, including at senior level

• Sufficient technical understanding to discuss services, data and integrations without needing to be a developer.

• Professional proficiency in English. Danish is an advantage because much of the team’s daily collaboration takes place in Danish.

It will be a strong advantage if you also have:

• Knowledge of commodity or energy trading, derivatives, risk management or financial back-office processes such as trade capture, settlement, invoicing or hedging.

• Experience with ETRM or CTRM systems.

• A background in software development or a hybrid technical/business role before moving closer to the business side.

Who you are

• Curious and motivated to understand how the business makes money and manages risk.

• Pragmatic and able to balance an ideal solution with what creates value now.

• Comfortable expressing an opinion, asking difficult questions and making complex topics understandable.

• Collaborative, accountable and motivated by being part of a product team rather than a separate analysis function.

• Interested in new tools, including AI, and thoughtful about where they genuinely improve quality and speed.

What we offer

At Bunker Holding, you will work in an international business where technology supports global trading and risk management. You will join experienced colleagues in Aarhus, gain direct access to both users and developers, and work with complex systems where your analysis helps shape priorities and solutions

You can expect a collaborative and practical environment, professional development opportunities, pension and health insurance, and flexible working arrangements that support a sustainable work life. Normal support hours are centred around the working day, and any holiday on-call coverage is handled through a rotating arrangement.

Ready to apply?

If this sounds like the challenge you are looking for, we would be happy to hear from you. Please upload your CV and application. We review applications on an ongoing basis and schedule interviews when we identify suitable candidates.

We believe diverse perspectives improve our decisions and solutions. Therefore, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single preference listed above. For any questions about the position, feel free to reach out to Team Lead, Jane Ingildsen at +45 2791 6688.

Bunker Holding

Bunker Holding is a global leader in purchasing, selling and supplying marine fuel and lube oil, while also providing risk management and other vital services to the shipping industry. The company operates through more than 1,600 ports worldwide and is present in 33 countries with 56 offices and more than 1,400 employees.

Bunker Holding is the largest company in USTC, a family-owned group with activities across energy, shipping, logistics, risk management, mobility, IT and sustainable solutions.
